newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville withdraws peak power offers for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville withdraws peak power offers for Wed.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) withdrew its next-day power offers during peak demand hours for Wednesday, the agency said Tuesday.
BPA continued to offer firm and non-firm power, but only during off-peak demand hours.

Previously, BPA offered 300 megawatts non-firm power during hours ending 1200-1800 PDT and 2200 PDT at $13.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $14.00 for Califoria-Oregon border (COB).

Wednesday prices for non-firm power for hours ending at 0600 PDT and 2300 PDT remained unchanged at $9.50 for all deliveries, while prices for hours ending 0100-0500 PDT and 2400 PDT were steady $9.00.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Wednesday was also unchanged at $9.00 per MWh.
